question: Rhesus monkeys <u>exhibit</u> patterns of <u>shy</u> similar <u>to</u> <u>those</u> in humans.

question: The number of <u>wild horses</u> on Assateague <u>are</u> increasing lately, <u>resulting</u> in <u>overgrazed</u> marsh and dune grasses.

question: <u>Unlikely</u> gas <u>sport</u> balloons, hot air balloons do not <u>have</u> <u>nets</u>.

question: Methane in wetlands <u>comes</u> <u>from</u> soil bacteria that <u>consumes</u> organic plant <u>matter</u>.

question: Alois Alzheimer made the first <u>observers</u> of the <u>telltale signs</u> of the disease that today <u>bears</u> <u>his name</u>.

question: Animism is the <u>belief</u> that objects and natural <u>phenomena</u> such as rivers, rocks, and wind are <u>live</u> and have <u>feelings</u>.

question: Newtonian physics <u>accounts</u> <u>for</u> the <u>observing</u> <u>orbits</u> of the planets and the moons.
